comment: IC-4 closed cache inventory (trilab union: opus B-6 C1-C22, sol B4 in-memory maps, fable 14-layer table). EVERY admission-steering cache names its invalidation authority here; the AST census in tests/test_cache_inventory.py enumerates lru_cache decorator sites plus cache/memo-named module-level and self-attribute bindings and refuses any site this file does not declare. A new cache without a registered invalidation authority fails CI. W9 (Wave-2 invalidation design) consumes these rows as its closed eviction scope. W44 SHADOW-EXCLUSION RIDER: every row additionally declares its shadow_exclusion mechanism (how shadow-rehearsal-marked records are kept from conferring reuse/authority through this cache); the census in tests/test_shadow_exclusion.py refuses a row without one.

caches.name: canonical-artifact-authority-solve-cache
caches.invalidation_authority: append-only supersession; W9 durable retirement row (Wave 2) for identity-stale entries
caches.shadow_exclusion: structural: authority conferral routes through the checkpoint fold, which quarantines shadow-marked chains as disclosed stale entries (W44; artifact_transactions._fold_transaction_chain)

caches.shadow_exclusion: structural: cached author results rehydrate only against checkpoint authority; authority conferral routes through the checkpoint fold, which quarantines shadow-marked chains as disclosed stale entries (W44; artifact_transactions._fold_transaction_chain)

caches.shadow_exclusion: not-authority-bearing: positive-only pure-validation memo; hits re-verify content identity live and confer no verdict or award authority

HARDENING FOLLOW-UP (routed to WS7 Wave-2 design notes): clear the memo at leg open so a device-id recycle within one long-lived driver process cannot serve a stale fstype.
caches.shadow_exclusion: not-record-bearing: filesystem-type probe result only

caches.key_axes: (leg cache key: campaign_id + paid generation_id) + resolved pinned command + expected version
caches.generation_binding: leg generation via the cache key: a new leg re-probes every declared pin
caches.invalidation_authority: key-scoped: a new (campaign, generation) key re-verifies; clear_toolchain_verification_cache() for tests and explicit re-probes; process-scoped (a driver restart clears it)
caches.shadow_exclusion: derived: the memo caches a subprocess --version probe of the pinned binary; the binary itself is the authority and the pin bump discipline (toolchain attestation) governs version moves
